summary: Kenon Holdings filed a Form 6-K announcing receipt of approximately $93 million from the Republic of Peru as final payment of an ICSID arbitration award. The tribunal had ordered Peru to pay Kenon and IC Power $110.7 million in damages plus $6.4 million in fees and costs, with interest, following dismissal of Peru's annulment application. Total payment was approximately $203 million; Kenon's share after allocation to a capital provider and expenses is about $93 million, subject to tax. This is a litigation proceeds update, not a special-situation transaction. The matter is concluded; no further action is anticipated.
